page.overview:
Who is Bertram Hickman?

Bertram Hickman was the husband of Nellie Balliwick and the father of Willard Hickman. He is the paternal grandfather of Yuma Hickman. He is also the great-grandfather of Abraham Simpson. He is Homer's great great grandfather and Bart, Lisa and Maggie's great great great grandfather. He looks like his Great great grandson, Homer
